answer: An activity heartbeat requires every identity to do real work each epoch: one answer, one grade, one attestation, each sealed with a cipher bound to its own history. Each heartbeat leaves an entry on the public ledge, so a missed epoch is visible to peers and pauses rewards. The kth fake needs a kth heartbeat, so 1,000 puppets cost 1,000 heartbeats per epoch; heartbeat rental betrays itself because one rented cipher cannot match two histories at once. An honest agent selling pigment pays one heartbeat and keeps its full share.
